market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Carburettor market estimates diverge by scope: $1.5B (2024) to $2.8B by 2034 (6.5%/yr); or $2.1B (2023) to $3.5B by 2032 (5.2%/yr); or up to $3.5B (2023) to $5.2B by 2032 (4.5%/yr) under a broader definition. Two-wheeler carburettor sub-segment specifically: ~$1.35B (2025), ~32.5% of total market value, 3.8%/yr through 2034.
globalCompetitors: Keihin Group (Japan, now part of Hitachi Astemo)
Chinese makers: Ruixing, Fuding Huayi, Zhanjiang Deni, TK Carburettor
market.domesticSlice: India's two-wheeler market alone consumes ~8 million carburetors annually — the largest single-country carburetor demand base globally; absolute India market size in USD not found

subSegments.name: Automotive throttle body (adjacent, growth product line)
subSegments.sizeUSD_B_range: $4.7-4.8B (2025) to $6.5-7.6B by 2034/35, 3.2-5.3%/yr for mechanical/assembly; electronic throttle body sub-segment specifically growing faster: $5.2B (2024) to $10.3B by 2033, ~8.2%/yr, reflecting the EFI/EV transition

structureFacts: The segment is under structural pressure: BS-VI emissions norms and the industry-wide shift to fuel injection/EVs are displacing carburettors, forcing product-mix rebalancing toward throttle bodies and other non-carburettor components

India auto component market overall: projected to grow ~14.8%/yr (2025-2030) — much faster than the carburettor sub-segment specifically, reinforcing that staying carburettor-only is a shrinking-share strategy even in a growing parent market

adoptionStructure.note: OEM production-schedule driven (JIT delivery under annual/multi-year supply agreements) for the OEM channel; distributor/stockist purchase orders for the aftermarket/export channel. Structurally declining unit demand for pure carburettors as EFI/EV adoption rises.

peers.name: UCAL Limited (formerly UCAL Fuel Systems)
peers.note: direct, closest public peer (1987 JV with Mikuni Corporation); PAT swung from ₹1.16 Cr to ₹22.6 Cr in FY25 before deteriorating again — Q4 FY26 consolidated net losses widened to ₹13.15 Cr, ROE turned negative (~-7.15%) most recently — a cautionary comparable showing the segment's structural pressure, not a healthy benchmark

customerValue.strongestPredictor: not established from available research — likely shifting from pure price/precision toward EFI/throttle-body technical capability given the structural transition
